Commentary.Commentary: Right then! This is all we have from this second ODI and the series now moves to Newlands, Cape Town for the third and final ODI. The series is already sealed by South Africa but India would like to avoid a whitewash here. The final ODI will take place on Sunday, 23rd December and the action starts at 2.00 pm IST (8.30 am GMT). But as you know, our coverage will start well in advance. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Quinton de Kock is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his brilliant performace with the bat. He says that it was nice to get out there and score some runs. Mentions that lack of game time obviously catches up but says it was just good to be out there and score. Tells that the more he batted, the more he felt that his rhythm was back. Says that he and Janneman Malan had a good partnership. Says that they share a great understanding. On asked how life is as a father, he says that he had only a couple of days to spend at home. Adds that his perspective has changed on life.

Temba Bavuma, the South African skipper says that he is very happy.  He adds that this was the objective before the series but he did not expect to win the series in just two games. He states that Quinton de Kock played well and showed how valuable a player he is. He mentions that they have a lot of self-belief and they fight for each other and they try to put a  team effort. He adds that no one had many expectations from them and they have done really well here. He states that the spinners have done a super job. He mentions that he enjoys captaincy right from domestic cricket and and it is probably because he thinks too deeply about the game. He adds that 3-0 sounds better than 2-1 and hopefully they can do well in the final game.

KL Rahul, the Indian skipper says that South Africa is playing good cricket at home and they are making some mistakes and it needs to be looked upon. He says that it is a learning curve for them. Mentions that they are a team that takes pride in winning but it has been a good learning for them and hopes that they grow from this. Tells that the wicket does feel like one at home and it didn't look like they will chase it down but credits them for batting really well. Adds that the way Rishabh Pant batted was good and he targeted areas where he is strong. Says that Shardul Thakur showed that he can bat down the order. Tells that Bumrah bowled superbly and Yuzvendra Chahal was also good as well. Says that these are the few positives but they love challenges and have been short in the first two games and tells that they will now look to win the last match. On asked about team changes, he says that it is too soon to tell.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

India have been really flat with the ball. They never looked like putting pressure on the South African bowlers and easy singles were given away quite easily throughout the innings. The man with the golden arm, Shardul Thakur eventually got the wicket of Quinton de Kock but the third wicket partnership between Bavuma and Malan ensured that India does not comeback into the game. India’s strike bowler, Bumrah got the wicket of Bavuma and Chahal also managed to get rid of Malan after that. But it was too late till then and India have been handed a humiliating series defeat here.

South Africa have pulled off a very clinical win here. They needed 288 to chase and the game seemed to be on a balance at the end of the first innings. But the way South Africa have gone about their chase has been very impressive. They kept the pressure on Indian bowlers right from the start as Quinton de Kock and Janneman Malan never let any bowler settle. Both the openers missed out on a well-deserved century but they had done their job till then and it was easy for the batters after them to take their side home. Bavuma batted solidly at number 3 and then Rassie van der Dussen and Aiden Markram finished things off for their side quite comfortably.

South Africa clinch the ODI series in a rather comfortable fashion with still a game to go. The dressing room erupts and full credit to this South African unit for their brilliant performance. They have chased down this total with ease and have carried the momentum they gained in the Test series into this ODI series. India will be disappointed with their effort with the ball especially after a decent performance with the bat earlier in the day. Indian spinners have been outbowled by the South African spinners in both the games and as a result, India have been beaten comprehensively in this ODI series. So the post-Kohli era in ODIs has started on a poor note for India.

Aiden Markram hits the winning runs! Shreyas Iyer bowls it short, on off. Aiden Markram works it to mid off for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end and Aiden Markram makes it back with a dive. The fielder didn't hit the stumps though and with that, SOUTH AFRICA WIN THE SERIES AND WIN THE MATCH BY 7 WICKETS!
Interestingly, KL Rahul hands the ball to Shreyas Iyer. Just 1 run is needed and KL Rahul asks Shreyas Iyer to bowl.
Fuller in length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen presses forward and blocks it out.
On a good length, on off. Aiden Markram punches it to extra cover. He sets off for a quick single. There is a shy at the bowler's end from the fielder but he misses.
On a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen steers it to deep cover for a single.
Short of a length, on middle. Pulled to deep mid-wicket. Rassie van der Dussen calls for two and gets it comfortably.
Length ball, on the pads. Pushed to long on for a single again.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for a single.
Short of a length, on middle. Aiden Markram again for the pull but misses. Just 7 needed now.
Fuller, on off. Drilled down to mid on for a single.
Short of a length, on middle. Aiden Markram is early on his pull. He misses and gets hit on the body and the ball rolls to the off side for a leg bye.
A full toss, outside off. Aiden Markram goes hard at it but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Good-length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives this on the up through covers for three runs.
Back of a length, angling in on leg. Rassie van der Dussen plays it with soft hands and blocks it out.
Fuller in length, outside off. Aiden Markram digs it out. Just 12 needed now!
A low full toss, on off. Aiden Markram drives this with ease to long off for a brace.
On middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen steps out and tucks it to deep square leg for one.
Length ball, on off. Aiden Markram chips his drive to long off for a single.

Ouch! That must have hurt! Rassie van der Dussen is down on the floor. Length ball, on middle. Aiden Markram drives it uppishly and it hits Rassie van der Dussen right in the box. He seems fine now though.
Good-length ball, on middle, nipping in. Aiden Markram looks to pull but misses. Rishabh Pant does well to dive to his left to stop the ball.
Outside off, poked to point.
Around off, Rassie van der Dussen defends it to point.
WIDE! Short of a length, going down the leg side. Wided.
Good-length ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
A low full toss, on off. Aiden Markram drives it to mid off for a single.
Slower one again and Aiden Markram gets beaten by it again. Length ball, outside off. Aiden Markram makes some room and has a swing at it but misses.
Slower bouncer, outside off. Aiden Markram goes for the pull but there was no pace on the ball. Ends up playing it to backward point.
Jasprit Bumrah (8.0-0-31-1) is back into the attack.
Length ball, on off. Aiden Markram punches it to long off for one.
On off, punched towards covers.
FOUR! Back of a length, on leg. Aiden Markram pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Bhuvneshwar Kumar coninues to be expensive.
FOUR! Shot! So pleasing to the eyes! Fuller in length, on middle. Aiden Markram extends the elbows and lifts it over extra cover for a boundary. Pure elegance!

Length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen steers it to point. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end and scores a direct hit. Aiden Markram was well in though. The ball ricochets off the stumps and rolls to long on. The batters collect a single. No reaction from Bhuvneshwar Kumar. Just walks back to his bowling mark.
On a good length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it through covers for another brace.
Tossed up, on off. Aiden Markram rocks back and carves it past point for a couple of runs. Good running between the wickets. 30 needed from 42 balls.
On the pads, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on off, Aiden Markram rocks back and works it to long off for one.
Loopy ball, on leg. Aiden Markram advances again and keeps it out.
On leg, Aiden Markram uses his feet and punches it to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to deep cover for a single. 5 runs from the over but that is still more than the required rate. 35 needed now from 48 balls.
On a good length, on leg. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to mid on.
Outside off, Aiden Markram guides it to deep cover for another single.
On a good length, on off. Punched straight to cover.
On a length, outside off. Steered to deep cover for just one.
Length ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to sweeper cover for a brace. 250 up for South Africa!
On middle, turned to deep square leg for a single. 40 needed from 54 balls.
Flighted ball, on off. Aiden Markram drives it to long on for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Aiden Markram steps out and pushes it back to the bowler.
Another quick ball, on off. Aiden Markram clips it to mid-wicket.
Rassie van der Dussen bunts this loopy ball to long on for a single.
Close! Ravichandran Ashwin cannot believe that didn't hit the stumps. Was a quicker ball, around off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to cut but misses. It was whiskers away from hitting the off stump.
A dot to end the over! A length delivery on middle. Aiden Markram works it to mid-wicket. 43 needed now from 60 balls.
On a length, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen works it to fine leg for a single.
A yorker length delivery on off. Aiden Markram digs it out square of the wicket towards the off side for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Aiden Markram drives it to covers this time.
FOUR! Short of a length, on leg. Aiden Markram pulls it to the fine leg region for a boundary. India are just leaking runs at the moment. 20 off the last two overs and 6 off this already.
A length delivery on middle. Aiden Markram works it to dep mid-wicket for a couple.
Slightly short again on off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to deep extra cover for a couple. Good over for South Africa.
Shorter in length outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it to backward point.
FOUR! Another boundary! A carrom ball and it is on the shorter side on off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it through covers for a lovely boundary.
Shorter length on off. Aiden Markram punches it to covers but the fielder in the ring does well and stops it with a dive. Only a single in the end.
A fuller delivery on off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to covers for a single this time.
FOUR! Ashwin is greeted with a boundary in his new spell! A fuller delivery on off. Rassie van der Dussen reverse-paddles it and gets it fine towards third man fence for a boundary.
A slightly shorter length delivery on off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it through covers. Ashwin runs across and stops it with his boot. Three runs taken.

Another beautiful delivery by Chahal. A classic leg-spinner's delivery. Tossed up on off. Rassie van der Dussen presses forward to defend but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade as it turns away sharply.
Shorter in length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to covers this time.
A tossed up delivery on off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes this to cover-point.
Slightly shortter in length. Aiden Markram again sweeps and gets it to deep square leg this time for a single.
FOUR! Superb shot! A fuller delivery on off. Aiden Markram sweeps and sweeps it well. This one races through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Just two runs from the over! Back of a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen taps it to backward point.
A fuller delivery on off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to covers this time.
Back of a length, outside off. Aiden Markram looks to dab it towards the off side. He gets the inside edge and a single is taken square of the wicket on the leg side.
On a length, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen gets across and works it to fine leg for a single.
On a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to cover.
Fuller in length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen defends it out.

Ohh..almost another wicket! A shorter length delivery on off. Aiden Markram cuts it to covers and thenRassie van der Dussen looks for a single. He is sent back by his partner and Rahul fires in a throw at the bowler's end. Luckily for Rassie van der Dussen, he misses. He was well short of his crease and it would have been curtains for him had that hit.
A fuller delivery on off. Rassie van der Dussen works it towards the leg side for a single.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Bavuma departs and two quick wickets for India now. A nicely tossed up delivery on off. Bavuma tries to work it away towards the on side. He gets the leading edge and ball goes straight towards Yuzvendra Chahal. He takes a fine catch and India will now to look to capitailse on this opening now. Still South Africa's game to lose from here.
Ohh..nicely bowled! A tossed up delivery on off. Bavuma pushes it towards the off side.
A fuller delivery on middle. Aiden Markram sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A tossed up delivery on middle. Aiden Markram defends it solidly off the front foot.
A slight misfield there allows a single. A fuller delivery on middle. Aiden Markram clips it to short mid-wicket. The fielder there misfields and a single is taken. 75 needed now from 90 balls.
On a length, on middle. Aiden Markram blocks it out solidly.
Aiden Markram walks out at number 4.

OUT! BOWLED! Janneman Malan misses out on a well-deserved century by 9 runs! Got to feel for Janneman Malan. Played so well but has to depart. Back of a length, angling in on leg, was a slower one as well. Jasprit Bumrah just rolls his finger over this time. Janneman Malan gets beaten by the lack of pace and gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball takes the gloves and rolls back to dislodge the bails. End of an excellent knock from Janneman Malan. He walks off to a standing ovation. A much-needed breakthrough for India but South Africa still right on top.
Full and on leg, Janneman Malan digs it out to mid-wicket.
Around off, Janneman Malan taps it to point.
Back of a length, around off. Temba Bavuma fends it away to third man for a single.
Back of a length, on leg. Temba Bavuma punches it to long on and retains the strike. South Africa need just 77 runs now and have 16 overs to get that.
FOUR! Deft touch! Escapes the gloves of the keeper and gets a boundary again. On a good length, around off. Temba Bavuma deliberately plays it late. It goes past Pant and into the third man fence.

FOUR! Temba Bavuma is in some form. We saw that in the Test series and in the first ODI and now carrying that rich form in this match as well. Short and on middle, Temba Bavuma pulls it to long on for a boundary.
This is pushed to long on for a single.
FOUR! Janneman Malan enters the nervous 90s now! Length ball, outside off. Janneman Malan drives it perfectly through point. The timing and placement was equisite and gets a boundary.
On a length, outside off. Janneman Malan pushes it to covers.

Inside edge but drops short of Rishabh Pant! Good-length ball, outside off, nipping in. Temba Bavuma looks to drive but gets an inside edge. The ball though falls inches short of Rishabh Pant despite his dive ahead. Luck still favoring South Africa.
On middle, turned to mid-wicket.
Good-length ball, angling into the pads. Janneman Malan tucks it to fine leg for one.
On a good length, outside off. Janneman Malan prods and blocks it to covers.
Fuller in length, outside off. Janneman Malan bunts it to mid-wicket.
On a length, outside off. Janneman Malan mistimes his cut and the ball rolls back to the keeper.

Drinks! South Africa are running away with the game here. Shardul Thakur got the wicket of Quinton de Kock but that was the only thing to cheer for India. The bowling is looking flat and India need quick wickets here, otherwise the game will be done and dusted soon. 92 needed now from 108 balls. Jasprit Bumrah (5.0-0-26-0) is brought back into the attack.
Length ball, hit hard but straight to covers.
Full and on off, Janneman Malan drives it through covers for a single.
Deft touch! Short of a length, outside off. Temba Bavuma guides it to third man for a single.
On a length, on leg. Temba Bavuma flicks it to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
On a length, on off. Janneman Malan punches it to sweeper cover and jogs to the other end.

FOUR! Janneman Malan wants to get to his century quickly now. Although, this was a poor ball and needed to be punished. Dragged it short and down the leg side, Janneman Malan pulled it behind square on the leg side and got the desired result. A boundary.
Shardul Thakur (3.0-0-12-1) is back into the attack.
On middle, worked to long on for a single. Another good over for South Africa.

Nothing going India's way. This was touch short, outside off. Temba Bavuma rocks back and cuts it straight to point. Virat Kohli collects it and throws it wide of Rishabh Pant. There is no one backing up and the batters take a run off overthrows.
Flighted ball, on middle and leg. Temba Bavuma defends it out.
Flighted delivery, on middle. Janneman Malan once again sweeps it deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Janneman Malan defends it with soft hands.

FOUR! Yet another boundary for Janneman Malan! Gets into the position of reverse-sweeping even before Yuzvendra Chahal bowls. Was a loopy ball and Janneman Malan sends it to deep point for a boundary.
Back of a length, on middle. Bavuma works it to backward square leg. The batters gets back for a couple as Chahal cuts it off. 108 needed now from 120 balls.
A length delivery on off. Bavuma dabs it to point this time.
A length delivery on off at 118 kph this time. Bavuma pushes this off the inside half of his blade to mid-wicket.
On a length, on off at 107 kph. Malan drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
A fuller delivery on leg. Malan flicks it straight to short fine leg this time.
Short of a length, on off. Temba Bavuma punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller and outside off again. Malan looks to sweep but gets beaten again as the ball turns away.
Nicely bowled! Turn there for Chahal! A fuller delivery outside off, Malan looks to dab it away but misses as the ball turns away sharply.
A fuller delivery on middle. Bavuma sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
In the air but safe! A fuller delivery on middle. Malan looks to paddle-sweep but gets the top edge. The ball goes in the air towards fine leg and a single is taken.
On off and Malan punches it to cover-point. Dot ball.
Shorter length delivery on off. Bavuma pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This time it is bowled at 121 kph. On a length, on middle. Bavuma works it to deep mid-wicket for a single. He retains the strike.
A fuller delivery on off at 106 kph. Malan drives it to long off for a single.
A length delivery on off. Bavuma drives and gets the inside half of his blade. The ball goes towards deep square leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Malan eases it down to long on for a single.
On the pads, it is worked away to backward square leg for a single.
A length delivery on middle. Malan works it to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR BYES! Ohh...superb delivery this! A tossed up delivery on middle and leg. Bavuma looks to work it away towards the on side. But the ball turns away sharply and beats the outside edge of his blade. Pant behind the stumps also moves towards to his left but misses the ball. Beats everyone and it is four byes in the end as it races away towards the fence.
A fuller delivery on middle. Malan works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter length, outside off. Bavuma cuts it to covers. The fielder there half-stops it and a single is taken.
Good loopy delivery on off. Bavuma plays it back to the bowler.
Nicely tossed up on off. Malan drives it to long off for another easy single.
Shorter length on off. Malan cuts it to short third man this time.
A fuller delivery on off. Malan drives it to long off and gets a single.

In the air...but safe! A fuller delivery on off. Bavuma looks to drive but gets the bottom of his blade and ball loops in the air wide of mid off. Bhuvneshwar Kumar runs to his left but ball falls short of him and a single is taken.
A fuller delivery on off. Malan eases it down to long on for a single.
A length delivery on middle. Malan works it to mid-wicket now.
FOUR! Malan is latching on anything short! A  slightly shorter length delivery on middle. Malan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Iyer bowls this fuller outside off. Malan drives it to covers this time.
Flighted ball, around off. Temba Bavuma presses forward to defend.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Tossed up, on middle and leg. Temba Bavuma moves inside the line and sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary. Bhuvneshwar Kumar gives it a chase but in vain.
A low full toss on off. Malan eases it down to long on for a single.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, turning into the right-hander. Janneman Malan looks to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge. The ball goes uppishly towards covers for a single.
Drifting on the leg side, Temba Bavuma turns it to square leg for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Janneman Malan steers it to backward point. A tidy over from Venkatesh Iyer. Three runs from it.
Keeps it full and on middle, Janneman Malan drives it back to the bowler. Rishabh Pant is heard on the stump mic saying to Venkatesh Iyer that keep mixing things.
On a length, on middle. Bavuma works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Temba Bavuma dabs it to backward point.
Venkatesh Iyer comes on to bowl for the first time in the series.
Almost chopped on! Quicker and outside off, Janneman Malan looks to cut but gets an inside edge and it deflects Rishabh Pant's boots. The ball rolls to third man for a single.
Venkatesh Iyer starts with a short ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma dabs it to backward point for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Bavuma works it to mid-wicket this time.
On middle. Bavuma paddle-sweeps it fine towards long leg for a couple.
A fuller delivery around leg. Malan tucks it to fine leg for a single.
SIX! A half-tracker and punished! A shorter length delivery on off. Malan rocks back and slams it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Poor delivery.
On middle and turning into the batter. Malan turns it away towards square leg.

OUT! LBW! A low full toss, on middle, swung really late. De Kock looks to whip it on the leg side but misses. A loud appeal from Thakur and Pant but the umpire says no. Thakur is very confident and straightaway asks KL Rahul to review it. He listens to his teammate and challenges the umpire. UltraEdge shows that there is no bat invovled. Ball Tracking shows that the impact was in line and the ball was crashing into the base of midde stump and the third umpire asks the on-field umpire to reverse his decision. India retain their review and it is once again the man with the golden arm that strikes for India. Quinton de Kock departs after a superb knock but he is disappointed as he knows he could have converted this into a three digit score. Temba Bavuma walks out to bat.

Review! India have reviewed for a LBW against Quinton de Kock. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows that there is not bat invloved. The Ball Tracker rolls and it shows that the impact is in line and the the ball is hitting stumps. It is dead straight and the decison will be reversed. So Quinton de Kock has to walk back.
WIDE! Length ball, way too outside off. Quinton de Kock leaves it alone. Wided.

FIFTY! Janneman Malan reaches his fifty as well. Classy performance from the opener. Length ball, outside off. Janneman Malan punches it through covers for a single. His third fifty in ODIs. Raises his bat and soaks the applause from the dressing room.
WIDE! Thakur bowls it short this time and Pant standing up to the stumps jumps and stops it. Malan lets it go as it is too high and outside off. Wide called for height.
On a length, on middle. Malan works it to mid-wicket.
A length ball, on middle. Malan punches it straight to mid on this time.
Back of a length, on off. Quinton de Kock pulls it to deep square leg for a single.

Another missed chance? By the reaction of Rishabh Pant, it looks like it. Yup, a missed chance as there was an inside edge there. Good-length ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock gets inside the line and tries to swipe it across but gets an inside edge. Rishabh Pant is standing up close behind the stumps and he fails to pouch it. It was a tough chance though as it first hit the thigh pad of de Kock and then went over the stumps. Shardul Thakur has his hand over his head.
Full and on middle, swept to long leg and Quinton de Kock will keep the strike.
Flighted ball, outside off. Janneman Malan drives it through covers for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock drives it to long off for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Janneman Malan knocks it down the ground to to long on for one.
Smart batting from Janneman! Loopy ball, on off. Janneman Malan reaches out and paddles it to fine leg for a brace.
Tossed up, on leg. Janneman Malan turns it to mid-wicket.
So only one run from the over! Good bowling by Thakur. Back of a length, on off. Quinton de Kock only manages to play it back to the bowler.
On a length at 124 kph on middle. Quinton de Kock plays it back to the bowler.
This time Malan gets a single. A length ball, outside off. Malan calmly pushes it to sweeper cover for a single. India need to stop these easy singles.
On a length, on middle. Malan works it to mid-wicket. Three dots in a row now.
Back of a length, on off. Malan  pushes it to mid off. Another dot ball.
Back of a length, on off. Malan punches it to mid of this time.
A quicker delivery this time on off. Malan just defends this with soft hands towards covers and gets a single.
A nicely tossed up delivery on middle. Quinton de Kock turns it towards deep square leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Quinton de Kock drives it back to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery on off at 81 kph. Quinton de Kock heaves it towards deep mid-wicket. Virat Kohli at the deep runs across to his right and keeps it to just two runs.
A fuller delivery around leg. Malan sweeps it to fine leg and gets an easy single again.
A tossed up delivery on middle. Malan drives it to covers this time.
A fuller delivery on off. Quinton de Kock drives it crisply but straight to the fielder at cover.
FOUR! What a shot! A fuller delivery on off. Quinton de Kock gets across and sweeps it towards backward square leg for a boundary. He is looking set for a century here.
A length delivery, outside off at 128 kph. Malan punches it to sweeper cover for another easy single.
A length ball, on the pads. Quinton de Kock flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Thakur bowls this on a length at 127 kph around off. Quinton de Kock looks to drive and gets the inside half of his blade. The ball goes towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on off. Malan punches it to sweeper cover for a single.

DRINKS! South Africa are cruising along nicely here. Quinton de Kock have notched up his fifty and looks all set for a big score while Janneman Malan is supporting him equally well and is inching closer to his half century as well. Indian bowlers now need to chip in with some wickets to gain some momentum otherwise the game could slip out of their grasp in no time.  A bowling change now. Shardul Thakur is brought into the attack.
Flatter and quicker this time. This is shorter in length, on off. Malan looks to cut but gets the thick outside edge to short third man for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Quinton de Kock tucks it towards deep square leg for another single.
A fuller delivery on off. Malan sweeps this time and gets it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Nicely tossed up on off. Malan defends this off the front foot towards the off side.
Tossed up on off. Malan looks to sweep but gets the inside edge onto his back leg.
A full toss on middle. Quinton de Kock pushes it to long on for a single.
A single to end a very good over! A length ball, on off. Quinton de Kock drives it to long on and retains the strike with a single.
On a length, on off. Quinton de Kock blocks this onto the turf now.

SIX! South Africa are all over India now. 100 partnership comes up with this maximum. A Shorter length delivery on off. Quinton de Kock just pulls it in front of square powerfully for a maximum. Kumar is too slow to bowl this length.
Another length delivery on off. Malan just eases it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! This is not looking good for India. A length delivery on off. Malan takes a step or two forward and then drives it on up through covers for a boundary.
A length delivery on off. Malan looks to punch it towards the off side off the back foot. He gets the bottom of his blade and the ball goes onto the turf and towards the off side.
Full and outside off, driven to mid off. Things looking ominous for India. South Africa have a firm control over the game at the moment. India need wickets desperately here.
Loopy ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock nudges it to mid-wicket.
Short and on middle, worked to long on for a run.
Slower through the air again, on middle. Quinton de Kock turns it to mid-wicket for one.
Slower through the air, on middle. Janneman Malan pushes it gently to long off for a single.
Fligthed, full and on leg. Janneman Malan prods and blocks it out.
On a length, around off. Janneman Malan drags it down to long on for a single. Bhuvneshwar Kumar is not looking in his rhytm today. Has been expensive in his three overs.
Short of a length, outside off. Quinton de Kock pulls it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Back of a length, on leg. Tucked to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Short of a length, on middle. Janneman Malan gets into the position early and pulls it with power towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a good length, outside off. Quinton de Kock prods and drives it to mid off for one.
Length ball, outside off. Janneman Malan chops it towards covers for a single.
Flighted ball, outside off. Janneman Malan pushes it to long off for a single.
Flatter, on off. Janneman Malan defends it back to the bowler.
On the pads, Quinton de Kock uses his wrists to turn it past short fine leg. Venkatesh Iyer from deep square leg runs across and cuts it off. Saves a run for his side.
Very full, on middle and leg. Janneman Malan pushes it to long on for a run.
On middle, worked to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Quinton de Kock defends it out.
On a length, on off. Malan is on his toes again and punches it to mid off this time. Three runs from the over.
Back of a length at 126 kph on off. Malam stays upright and punches it to mid on.
On a length, around off. Quinton de Kock drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Quinton de Kock blocks it solidly from his crease.
Outside off, steered to point.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back into the attack.

FIFTY! Well fielded at cover but a wayward throw at the keeper's end allows Quinton de Kock to take one more. Good-length ball, on off. Quinton de Kock punches it to the right of cover. The fielder there dives and stops the ball. But throws the ball over Rishabh Pant and allows the batters to take a run more. Quinton de Kock raises his bat. He just loves batting India.
Tossed up, on middle. Janneman Malan sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Quicker one, down the leg side. Janneman Malan misses his flick. Wided.

Is Janneman Malan stumped? The replay rolls in and the umpire first checks whether there is an edge on that or not. The UltraEdge confirms no edge. The replay rolls in to check the stumping and it shows that Janneman Malan's feet is grounded. So no damage done.

NOT OUT! Tosses this one up nicely, outside off. Janneman Malan presses forward and looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge. Rishabh Pant whips the bails off and asks the umpire if it was out. The umpire wasn't sure so he takes it upstairs. Replay shows that Janneman Malan's feet were grounded when the bails were whipped off.
Floats it up, on middle. Quinton de Kock eases it down to long on for a run.
Loopy ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock reverse-sweeps it but finds the man at point.
On leg, Janneman Malan punches it off the back foot to long on for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal starts with a tossed up delivery, on middle. Quinton de Kock turns it to square leg for a single.
End of Powerplay 1! That means now 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of 40th over. Yuzvendra Chahal is into the attack now.

Review! India have taken a late review for LBW against Janneman Malan. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracker rolls and it shows impact is outside off. So the original decision stays and Janneman Malan survives.

NOT OUT! Flatter and full, outside off. Janneman Malan again for the reverse sweep but misses. He gets pinged on the pads. Rishabh Pant tells Ravichandran Ashwin that the ball didn't hit the bat so we can go for the review. And in fact, India does opt for it. UltraEdge shows there is no spike as the ball passes the bat. Ball Tracking shows that the ball was pitching outside off and the impact is outside off. So, India lose a review.
This is driven to long off for a run.
FOUR! Quinton de Kock continues to be aggressive! Slower through the air, outside off. Quinton de Kock uses his feet and lifts it overs covers. He loves this region and bags a boundary. Moves to 45.
Full and on leg, pushed to long on for one.
Tossed up, on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter ball, on off. Quinton de Kock cuts it to point. Venkatesh Iyer dives to his right and makes an important stop. Just a single.
Good running! Short of a length, outside off. Janneman Malan dabs it uppishly to deep point for a brace.
FOUR! Nicely played! The timing was good from Malan. On the pads, Janneman Malan gets on his toes and turns it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short of a length, on middle. Janneman Malan nudges it to mid-wicket.
Good-length ball, around off. Janneman Malan plays it towards covers.
On a good length, on leg. Janneman Malan looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.
On the pads, Quinton de Kock helps it on it's way to fine leg for a single.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket. A good over for South Africa now. 11 runs off it.

FOUR! Superb shot by Janneman Malan! A fuller delivery on middle. Janneman Malan gets on his knee and reverse-sweeps it through the backward point region. Good thinking this from the opener. Fifty-run stand comes up and South Africa are off to an ideal start.
Nicely tossed up around leg. Quinton de Kock takes it on full and works it to mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BOOM! And now he hits a maximum. Adds salt on the injury, does Quinton de Kock. Tossed up, on middle. Quinton de Kock gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps it over deep square leg for a biggie.

MISSED STUMPING! Tossed up nicely, outside off, spinning away. Quinton de Kock comes down the track and heaves but completely misses the ball. Rishabh Pant fails to collect it and Quinton de Kock gets a lifeline.
Tossed up, on off. Quinton de Kock defends it towards covers.
Short of a length, outside off. Janneman Malan mistimes his shot and defends it to the off side. He wanted to pull but pulled out at the end. A couple of good overs for India. Just 3 from this over.
On a good length, outside off. Janneman Malan punches it towards covers.
Length ball, on the pads. Janneman Malan closes the face of the bat early as he looks to work it on the leg side. Gets a leading edge towards covers.
On a length, outside off. Janneman Malan pushes it through covers and runs two. Good running!
Back of a length, on off. Janneman Malan stands up on his toes and meets the ball with a dead bat.
Back of a length, on middle. Quinton de Kock tucks it to square leg for a single.
Excellent over from Ravichandran Ashwin! A maiden over! Tossed up, on middle. Janneman Malan prods and knocks it back to the bowler.
Make that five now! Outside off, this it tapped to point.
Four dots in a row! Tossed up, on off. Janneman Malan blocks it out.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
Loopy ball, around off. Janneman Malan guides it to point.
Quicker one, on middle. Janneman Malan defends it out.
An attempted yorker this time. It is outside off and is very full. Malan steers it to third man for another single.
Slower delivery at 125 clicks. Back of a length, on middle. Quinton de Kock works it to square leg for a single.
A length ball, on off. Malan pushes it wide of mid off and takes another quick single.
Back of a length, on middle. Quinton de Kock looks to work it towards the on side but gets the leading edge. The ball goes towards mid off and a single is taken.
A length ball, on off. Quinton de Kock punches it to mid off this time.
Back of a length, on off. Quinton de Kock blocks it solidly.
A flatter and quicker delivery on middle. Quinton de Kock pushes it wide of mid on for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Driven to covers this time.
FOUR! This time he gets the boundary! A fuller delivery on off. Little width on offer and Quinton de Kock drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
Slightly shorter on off. Quinton de Kock makes room and punches it to covers yet again.
A fuller delivery on off. Quinton de Kock drives it to covers this time.
Ashwin tosses this up on middle. Malan pushes it to long on and gets a single.
So, Bhuvneshwar Kumar is removed off the attack straightaway. He gets replaced by Ravichandran Ashwin.
End of another good over for South Africa. A length delivery on off. Quinton de Kock taps it towards the off side and sets off for a quick single but is sent back by his partner.
FOUR! WOW! A length delivery on middle. Quinton de Kock leans forward and flicks it nonchalantly through mid-wicket for a boundary. Superb shot.
Pulls his length back a little this time and bowls this on off. Quinton de Kock is solid in his back foot defence.
Ohh...beaten! A good-length delivery and angling away from Quinton de Kock on off. Quinton de Kock looks to drive but misses.
A length ball, on off. Malan pushes it to covers and gets a single this time.
On a length, on off. Malan defends it solidly.
FOUR! Superb timing there! Back of a length, on off. Quinton de Kock punches this from his crease and gets this past mid on for another boundary. Expensive start from Bhuvneshwar Kumar.
WIDE! Bhuvneshwar Kumar goes 'round the wicket and bowls this down the leg side. Quinton de Kock lets it go.
SIX! This is poor bowling and Quinton de Kock is in mood today. Back of a length, on middle. Quinton de Kock just stays in his crease and pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum.
Back of a length, outside off. Quinton de Kock slaps it to mid off this time.

FOUR! Quinton de Kock looks in aggressive mood here! A length delivery on off. Quinton de Kock skips down the track and looks to hit it away. He gets the inside half of his blade and the ball races through mid-wicket for a boundary.
A length delivery on middle. Quinton de Kock works it towards the leg side.

Kumar starts with a length delivery that is swinging away. Malan looks to push it away from his body towards the off side. He gets the inside edge and the ball goes past the stumps behind square on the on side for a single.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar to bowl from the other end.
Back of a length, on off. Quinton de Kock dabs this towards the off side and looks for a single but is sent back. Good start for South Africa.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! A juicy half-volley on off. Quinton de Kock leans foward and drives it past mid off for a boundary. Superb timing.
Quinton de Kock is off the mark now. A length delivery on middle. Quinton de Kock clips it to deep square leg and gets a couple.
On a length, around off. Quinton de Kock dabs it to point this time.
On a length, on middle. Quinton de Kock looks to clip it away but he gets the inside edge of his blade and into the box. Quinton de Kock is smiling in pain.
Bumrah starts with a length delivery on middle and leg. Malan works it to fine leg for a single. Janneman Malan and South Africa are underway.
